source_evidence: But remember that all amounts payable are subject to the ability of the insurance company to pay. If the insurance company experiences financial distress, it may not be able to fully meet its obligations to you.
answer: An indexed annuity’s promised payments depend on the insurance company’s ability to pay. This creates insurance company credit risk: if the insurer experiences financial distress, it may not be able to meet all of its obligations to you. The annuity’s link to a market index does not remove this risk, so read the contract to understand the insurer’s obligations.
